data.text:
Parts of Metro Manila remain hazy and smoggy on Monday morning, April 20, due to smoke coming from the Navotas Sanitary Landfill, which caught fire on April 10. 

The Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) reported on Sunday that only four cities in Metro Manila recorded “good” to “fair” air quality levels, while most areas fell under “unhealthy” to “acutely unhealthy.” 

📸: Santi San Juan/MB

data.text:
A Night of Timeless Music and Legacy: NINA XX Celebrates 20 Years of a Diamond Icon

A landmark moment in Original Pilipino Music (OPM) history takes center stage as Asia’s Diamond Soul Siren, Nina, commemorates the 20th anniversary of her era-defining album Nina Live! with a spectacular concert event, NINA XX.

Set to unfold on May 9, 2026 (Saturday), 8:00 PM at the prestigious Newport Performing Arts Theater, this once-in-a-generation celebration promises an unforgettable evening of music, nostalgia, and vocal brilliance.

Widely regarded as one of the most influential albums in Philippine music history, Nina Live!—released in 2005, remains the best-selling live album by a Filipino artist and one of the few to achieve Diamond certification in the country.

Beyond its commercial success, the album redefined the OPM landscape, elevating live cover performances into a cultural phenomenon and embedding itself into the everyday soundtrack of Filipino life, from radio airwaves to karaoke sessions nationwide.

Two decades later, NINA XX revisits this iconic repertoire with renewed artistry and emotional depth. Fans can expect a powerful reimagining of beloved hits such as 'Love Moves in Mysterious Ways' and 'Through the Fire', delivered with the same passion that first captivated audiences—now enriched by years of musical evolution.
Joining Nina on this milestone evening are some of the country’s finest R&B and soul artists... Kris Lawrence, Thor, and Jay Durias, whose collective artistry promises dynamic collaborations and electrifying moments on stage.

The concert’s musical direction is helmed by the esteemed Soc Mina, ensuring a rich and masterfully orchestrated soundscape, while visionary Calvin Murphy Neria brings the production to life as Concert Director—crafting an immersive and emotionally resonant live experience.

Produced by Echo Jham Entertainment Productions in collaboration with Synth X, NINA XX stands as both a tribute and a reinvention, honoring a legacy while embracing the future of live performance.

As Nina herself reflects, the enduring appeal of Nina Live! lies in its authenticity, each performance feels like the first, each note carried by genuine emotion and connection with the audience.

That same spirit will define NINA XX—a concert not just to be watched, but to be felt.

Tickets are now available via TicketWorld at https://t.co/nhoEfgYcU0⁠

Don’t miss this historic night celebrating 20 years of music that shaped a generation.
